title: Former Lions star Tracy Scroggins dies at 56 after CTE battle, family announces

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Former Lions star Tracy Scroggins dies at 56 after CTE battle, family announces
sources.description: Tracy Scroggins, who played 10 seasons with the Detroit Lions, died at age 56 after battling suspected effects of CTE, his family announced on Feb. 9.
